blind.description: A stylized cartoon wooden doghouse or kennel with a gabled roof. It features an arched front entryway revealing floorboards inside, horizontal wooden wall planks, and four sturdy corner posts. The pitched roof is covered in reddish-brown wooden shingles and capped with a thick wooden ridge beam with blocky trim on the gables. Hand-painted stylized textures give it a warm, polished game-ready appearance.
blind.from_above: A rectangular view dominated by a central wooden ridge beam dividing two sloping roof sides with reddish-brown wood shingles, bordered by slightly protruding wooden bargeboards at the top and bottom edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall, roughly reaching lower thigh or waist height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about 2.5 to 3 feet in length and width.
